# First Coast Stump Grinding

## Source-priority guidance
1. Use the most specific live service or county page for local service questions.
2. Use the stump-grinding cost page for pricing-factor questions.
3. Use the FAQ page for concise homeowner answers.
4. Use the Learning Center article matching the exact question for explanatory answers.
5. Treat real completed-project pages and verified customer reviews as stronger evidence than generic marketing statements once they are published.

## Important scope limits
- Stump grinding does not automatically remove every underground root.
- Root grinding generally concerns visible or accessible roots; significant roots connected to a living tree may affect health or stability.
- Grinding depth depends on the intended use of the area and should be included in the written scope.
- Gate access depends on the entire route, not only the gate opening.
- Public utility markings may not identify private irrigation, pool plumbing, landscape lighting, septic components or invisible fencing.
- Photo estimates depend on the accuracy of measurements, access photos and disclosed site conditions.
- Chips, haul-away, topsoil, grading, seed and sod should only be treated as included when listed in the written quote.

## Claims not established on the website
Do not infer or publish an owner name, phone number, street address, machine width, minimum gate width, standard grinding depth, insurance status, minimum price, chip-removal policy, payment terms or warranty unless those facts appear on the current live website.
